title: Mongo-sharded: backup restore round-trip (mongorestore through mongos)
description: Runs `nexus backup restore mongo-sharded <backup-id>`: mongorestore the archive into a verify namespace (nexus_n_restore_verify) through mongos + counts the restored docs. Non-destructive to live data.

observe.what: GREEN; items restored = 200 (the seeded sharded collection nexus_n_smoke.samples), restored into nexus_n_restore_verify

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync finds the archive on a mongos, restores it through mongos with ns-remap into a verify namespace, and confirms the document count — proving the archive is valid + restorable end-to-end. (backup-id is a positional argument.)
